children: The HR professional joins with over 10 years of experience across pharmaceuticals, steel, consumer electricals and renewable energy

Group Pharma has appointed Nelson Chacko as General Manager – Human Resources, strengthening its leadership team as the pharmaceutical company looks to build organisational capabilities and support its business growth.

Chacko brings more than 10 years of experience in human resources management, HR business partnering, talent development, employee engagement and workforce management. He joins Group Pharma from Cipla, where he served as Senior Manager – HR for the West and South zones from June 2022 to November 2026, handling regional HR responsibilities.

Before Cipla, he worked with Tata Steel Long Products Limited as Manager – Business Unit HR, Sponge, and previously as Manager – Corporate HRM. During his tenure, he was involved in performance management, rewards and recognition, talent acquisition, HR policy, diversity and inclusion, and employee wellness initiatives.

Earlier, Chacko served as Assistant Manager – Human Resources at Crompton Greaves Consumer Electricals, where he worked as the Sales HR Business Partner for East India. He also spent nearly three years with Adani Group, handling HR business partnering for its renewable energy business and corporate HR services.

At Adani, his responsibilities included supporting HR operations across 42 solar and wind energy sites, alongside work involving payroll, statutory compliance, learning and development, talent management, employee engagement and HR analytics.

Chacko holds a Post Graduate Diploma in Human Resource Management from Xavier Institute of Social Service (XISS), where he studied between 2014 and 2016. His experience spans corporate HR functions as well as business-facing roles across multiple industries.

At Group Pharma, he will lead the human resources function, focusing on strengthening people practices, developing organisational capabilities and building a high-performance work culture. The company operates in dental and oral healthcare, with manufacturing and business operations supported by a workforce of more than 600 employees.
